number.representation: finite JSON int/double representable as finite IEEE754 binary32
number.negative: valid sample; M1 glass may reject out_of_range
number.invalid: valid=false and value=null; never synthetic zero

unknown_types: Future typed fields may carry arbitrary JSON values. Current consumers do not cache their values or turn them into zero. In a newly accepted complete snapshot, they revoke any old numeric candidate at that field_id without renewing a valid lease; numeric siblings remain usable and boot/sequence is recorded to prevent replay.

compatibility.old_rc: deprecated; no RC.1 source compatibility guarantee
compatibility.field_identity: Stable device_id+field_id; name does not change binding. Each accepted boot/sequence is a complete snapshot: missing, unsupported typed, malformed, invalid or mismatching-unit fields revoke old numeric candidates, while configuration bindings are retained.

snapshot_policy.identity_counter_update: Record each accepted boot/sequence even when no numeric field remains, so stale numeric replay cannot restore a revoked candidate
snapshot_policy.missing_field: invalidate old numeric cache; keep configuration
snapshot_policy.unknown_type: invalidate old numeric cache; ignore unknown value; no synthetic zero
snapshot_policy.retained_or_replayed: reject without changing accepted numeric snapshot
snapshot_policy.empty_object: Valid complete snapshot revokes all numeric candidates and records boot/sequence; configured sources remain saved.
